description: The marketplace's products, in display priority. The order sets the gallery's Product filter, card pills (the first two show, the rest fold into +N), the detail page's PRODUCT dropdown, and which variant a listing opens on by default. `suffix` picks a variant's OVERVIEW-<suffix>.md and DOCS-<suffix>.md files (generate-gallery.js) and is the short form of the ?product= query param (src/utils/productParam.ts). Names must match the approved product vocabulary in the marketplace repo's Config/approved_products.json.
